name: theme
title: Theme
summary: Loads the tokens and the Geist faces, follows the system appearance and lets people switch between light and dark.
use: Set it up once at the root of every app or site, before any other component.
anatomy: Tokens for the light and dark appearance
The theme toggle (an icon button with the contrast icon)

options.name: appearance
options.description: Follow the system until the person picks one. The choice is remembered.

rules: Every color comes from a token, so both appearances work without extra code.
The toggle always uses the contrast icon and is labelled “Switch theme”.
accessibility: The toggle has an accessible label and a 44pt target.
